meta.blurb: 70% to living costs, 20% to savings, 10% to debt paydown (or giving, if you have no debt). A looser cousin of 50/30/20 for high-cost households.
meta.source: https://www.bestmoney.com/financial-advisor/learn-more/70-20-10-rule (Duke University's student loans and personal finance office defines the version with debt in the 10%.)
